seed.policy: rawfiber AND originalP2>=.9. Native4connected components, area>=16*s^2; examine at most2 ranked by area, but if>2 eligible reject excessive_seed_hypotheses rather than hide others. Need exactly1 RGB/geometry-qualified seed. High neural alone never establishes identity; no FOV entry hard rule.

appearance.policy: c=RGB/(sumRGB+1e-6), immutable per-frame median/MAD. sigma_pixel=max(robust_seed_sigma,3/(sumDN+3)); RMS standardized chroma distance<=3, Euclidean distance from sampled local background exceeds distance from fixed seed by>.02. No V/hue threshold. Excessive propagated noise => unknown, not semantic background. Seed blue-excess median must exceed flank-background median by2*max(background blue MAD,.01). No newly grown pixel updates seed model.

geometry.policy: Current paired RGB edges witness each section. Recenter on witnessed edge midpoint and update tangent from successive centers; no fixed whole-PCA strip. Both seed ends searched; first unsupported/invalid section stops that branch. Bounds/turn/width failures reject ALL new proposal pixels for frame, no success-only clipping. Corridors between witnessed sections only constrain where RGB eligibility is evaluated; never filled as fiber.

growth.policy: Compute RGB eligibility on witnessed-corridor/seed pixels only. Native4connectedComponents, pick only color-eligible root intersecting selected trusted seed; multiple eligible seed-root components>=minimum seed pixels => ambiguity rejection. Raw stone is a barrier BEFORE connectivity. No dilation/closing/gap bridging or hidden reconnection. Save reachable pre-stone counterpart solely for conflict audit; it never seeds/traverses actual growth. All geometry/area rejection proposals retained; accepted new candidate only rawbackground pixels. Existing fiber/stone never deleted. GT255 never enters inference.

tip.policy: After positive accepted growth, inspect original RGB without blue threshold. Boundary requires currentRGB contrast>=.04; inspect2sections further along current tangent: continuing paired edges => internal_transition; adjacent current stone and RGBboundary => occlusion_suspected. Visible_end_candidate only when current paired outline narrows<=.5 previous width and axial boundary supported; seed/window/budget/FOV termination cannot produce asserted tip. No physical accuracy or filled cap.

t1.policy: Actually execute frozen T1 on original raw network probability every video frame, never feed growth back. Prior valid age<=3 and source/shape/time rules unchanged. Advice labels branch directions and abnormal truncation only. Strong current growth evidence not vetoed, no prior pixels or extra accepted candidate. B1/B2 candidate masks byte-identical. Static has no T1/video state. Warmup scratch state reset per video.

execution.total_p95: <=1000/sourceFPS separately each video; direct synchronized measurement
execution.interface: one originalstone+one originalfiber forward, FP32,batch1,both native3class maps+raw mask CPU; growth+tip+T1+necessary metadata in pipeline. Offline detailed export counted in cycle FPS, not silently omitted.

quality.virtual: Only originalbackground candidate set to fiber, retain ALL originalstone/fiber. Counterfactual diagnostic, not actual semantic output. All actual deltas0. Virtual per-class Dice/Precision/Recall/boundary and original29/classwise nonregression plus candidate TP/FP/FN; empty candidate denominator unavailable/fail. All132 including6disputes remain in primary metrics. No anatomical tip truth=>metrics null.

stop: One fixed configuration; no thresholds/color/range/T1 sweeps or training. All arms full both videos even rejection. Failure preserves negative result; passing only motivates a separate pixel-modification protocol, never deployment/default adoption.
constraints: Frozen existing code/weights/default/labels/521-132-144-29 and70; no TRAIN/144test pixels, video derivatives validation only, stone_new excluded, oldmixedA0 inference only. No shared validation color/template calibration or pseudo labels. Same-frame anchor ephemeral. No real calibration from Godot. No S3.
